profile.subtitleJa: コハテ系の歌い手として名が記されます。
profile.summaryJa: 歴代誌上6:33は、ヘマンをコハテ系の歌い手、ヨエルの子、サムエルの子孫として記しています。

facts.textJa: レビ人はヨエルの子ヘマンを任命し、アサフとエタンとともに名を挙げます。
歌い手のヘマン、アサフ、エタンには青銅のシンバルが割り当てられます。
ヘマンとエドトンは、主への感謝を歌うため選ばれた人々に含まれます。
ヘマンとエドトンは楽器を用いる歌に関わる人々として挙げられます。
ダビデと軍の指揮者たちは、ヘマン、アサフ、エドトンの子らを音楽奉仕に任命します。
本文はヘマンの子らを名前で列挙します。
ヘマンは「神の言葉における王の先見者」と呼ばれ、十四人の息子と三人の娘を与えられたと記されます。
ヘマンの子らは神殿で歌う奉仕に就き、ヘマンらは王の指揮下に置かれます。

wikipedia.title: Heman the Ezrahite
wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版記事は詩編88の表題にあるヘマンを扱い、歴代誌の音楽奉仕者ヘマンと同一人物である可能性を述べますが、確定とはしていません。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;
and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever;
and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.

Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:
Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

All these were under the hands of their father for song in the LORD’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.
The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: 関連の説明に限る。Heman the Ezrahiteとこのプロフィールを同一人物と断定しない。

review.remainingUncertaintyJa: 本文内の2:6と6:33以下は異なる系譜の同名者。記事が扱う詩編のヘマンと歌い手の同一性も断定できない。
